matrix.name: Total Core Conservation & Soul Core Tracking
matrix.description: System-wide core invariant: sum of cores across all zones (reserve, field, trash, void, life) is strictly conserved. Soul Core location is unique and strictly tracked.

matrix.name: Transactional Cost Payment & Preflight Validation
matrix.description: Two-phase transactional payment: preflight validation prevents partial mutation; committed payments block duplicate commits and cannot be rolled back by downstream handler failure.

matrix.name: Stage 4 Atomic Activation Commitment
matrix.description: Activation budget (Once per turn, Once per game, Same Name) is reserved pre-flight and atomically consumed only upon successful cost payment or target selection.

matrix.name: Structured Condition Evaluator (4-State Logic)
matrix.description: Deterministic 4-state condition evaluation (TRUE, FALSE, UNSUPPORTED, INVALID_CONTEXT). Fail-closed on unmet predicates with zero resource consumption.

matrix.name: Unified Target Selection & Armor/Heavy Armor Protection
matrix.description: Target candidate generation evaluates zone, card type, BP/Cost/Level comparisons, and strictly excludes targets protected by Armor, Heavy Armor, or effect immunities.

matrix.name: State-Based Actions & Infinite Loop Prevention
matrix.description: Automatic rules execution: 0-core spirits sent to trash, 0-BP spirits destroyed, 0-life defeat. Stabilization loop settles chained triggers; StabilizationLoopError prevents infinite loops.

matrix.name: Deterministic Trigger Ordering & Queue Lifecycle
matrix.description: Active player triggers ordered before non-turn player; within each player ordered by zone, stack, and ability index. Source departure automatically cancels pending field triggers.

matrix.name: Continuous Layer & Dynamic Modifier Pruning
matrix.description: Derived BP, levels, symbols, and keywords recomputed dynamically without mutating base card structures. Modifiers pruned cleanly at scope boundaries (BATTLE, ATTACK, TURN).

matrix.name: Ownership vs Controller Zone Routing
matrix.description: When cards leave the field (destroyed, bounced, banished), they always return to their canonical owner's zone (hand, trash, deck), even if controlled by the opponent.

matrix.name: Replacement Effect Interception Pipeline
matrix.description: Intercepts destruction, life loss, and card departure events. Single-stage replacement verified; multi-replacement arbitration active.
